Blocks.Text: The Organization Products DMA API is used to fetch product information. The product info includes product name, description, URL, logo, category, CTA, lead-gen form, etc.
This API currently provides the following methods:

Get product related info for the given product ID.
Batch get to retrieve all matching products for the given set of product IDs.
Finder organization to return all products owned by an organization.
Finder organizationalPage to retrieve all products owned by an organizational page.
Finder vanityName to retrieve all the products owned by an organization by their corresponding vanity name where vanityName is product's unique name used in URLs.

Rows.Text: Retrieve your organization’s posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data. Retrieve your organization’s pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor and content analytics). Restricted to organizations in which the authenticated member has one of the following company page roles. ADMINISTRATORCONTENT_ADMINISTRATOR

This field will only be populated if versionedLeadGenForm is non-null and an organizational admin has taken action to download the lead gen form response report, capturing the last download time of the report and the last admin to download the report.

Denotes if product pricing was ever modified by an admin. This field is only set to true when the modifications originate from an admin and not when it originates from other sources (i.e. 3rd party ingestion flows).

Denotes if free-trial is available for the product. The field is optional in the event this information is not provided by admins and/or not available in the 3rd party dataset used to backfill product pricing data.
Derived and read only field denoting whether the pricing plans attribute contains a free plan.
Field for external URL where additional pricing information on the product can be found. URL is in en_US locale. Can be null if the admin did not provide the pricing URL.
List of product pricing plans, such as free-tier, subscription-based, and custom. The ordering of the pricing plan is the order in which the plans will show-up on the product page.
Title of the pricing plan (e.g., "Standard", "Plus", "Enterprise"). Title is in en_US locale.
Description of the pricing plan. Description is in en_US locale.
union[freePrice: ProductFreePrice, fixedPrice: ProductFixedPrice, customPrice: ProductCustomPrice]

Pricing details of the plan. ProductFreePrice represents a free-tier for a product. ProductFixedPrice represents a product price that is dependent on charge frequency and payment model. ProductCustomPrice represents a product price that is custom and requires contact with the product sale's team.
Amount of money to charge. Currency is in USD.
Indicates whether the price is determined on a monthly basis, yearly basis, etc. Value enums include: YEARLYMONTHLYWEEKLYDAILYONCE
Indicates the basis for determining price. Value enums include: FLATPER_USER
